messages:
alana (Docs): Heads-up: Product set a v1->v2 sunset date. We need a tight docs plan: migration quickstart, short SDK snippets, model-swap patterns, redirect rules, and a tiny set of 'safeguard' code bits teams can drop in. Can folks volunteer?

kevin (SDK): I can do the SDK side. Plan: a 4-line compat wrapper in Py/TS, a short note on changed function names, and unit tests. Ill open a draft PR today.

matt (Eng): For model swaps add an explicit runtime fallback pattern and show how to detect incompatibility errors + fall back to a pinned variant. Also call out quota/rate-limit header parsing so customers can backoff gracefully.

nina (Product): Docs must include a brief "why this changed" blurb and a short migration checklist: update client, swap model id, test embeddings, and verify streaming framing. Marketing wants docs live 2 business days before the public notice.

yara (DevRel): I'll put a tiny sample-app with a feature flag that toggles auto-fallback on regression. Will link it from the quickstart and add a minimal test harness.

sam (Support): Please add a one-click rollback snippet (config switch) and a short Dedicated-specific runbook: how to pin capacity, override model routing, and who to contact. That cuts down support tickets during the window.

kevin (SDK): Draft PR: https://github.com/redwoodinc/docs/pull/2501  contains compat wrappers and short migration steps. Needs content review for phrasing and examples.

alana (Docs): Reminder: keep inline snippets <=7 lines. Longer recipes go into sample-app and we link with "Full example". I'll prepare a page scaffold and troubleshooting mini-FAQ (errors to expect, quick fixes).

matt (Eng): Added a note in the SDK PR about stream chunk framing change in v2 and how to reassemble in consumers. Recommend adding a small consumer snippet showing reassembly loop.

deploy-bot: Preview deployed: https://deploy.preview.redwood.ai/sha/ff3344  migration quickstart + snippets live on preview, please smoke-test.

yara (DevRel): :thumbsup: I'll open the sample-app PR tomorrow and link it. Also will create a tiny regression check snippet showing cosine similarity for embeddings to detect large shifts post-swap. Optional, but helpful.

alana (Docs): Thanks everyone. I'll open the umbrella PR to wire redirects and the troubleshooting section once your PRs are ready. Ping here when final reviews are done so we can merge before marketing sends the notice.
